item: Two ways to hear one pattern
content: Neely compares the change of feel in Cool 7 with a Necker cube: the same pattern has two readings. Two processes work together: a pulse morph and a metric modulation. He names Tigran Hamasyan and Malcolm Braff as earlier users; another analyst calls the device 'shifting gravity centers'. The source may be aksak rhythm.
parameters: 2 readings of one 14-eighth cycle: 4/4 with a short beat, or 7/4

item: The audience as a rhythm instrument
content: Before a hard passage the audience gets a two-step dance or a clap pattern. Steady movement lets them feel the change of pulse in the body. Fans call for odd time signatures at the end of concerts.
parameters: Dance: 2 steps right, 2 steps left. Clap pattern in 7/8. Count games: '1, 2, 1 2 3 4 5'; counting from five to seven with no six

content: The breakdown keeps the pulse and makes the subdivision slower for impact. A reviewer hears djent-style breakdowns in concert.
parameters: 11 notes per beat to 7 notes per beat
where: Against the Fall of Night (title track); concerts

content: Threshold puts notes at the fast limit of rhythm on a very slow pulse. A live review: the piece plays fast and slow at the same time to change perception.
parameters: 33 BPM pulse; notes 96 ms apart (computed)

content: In a 2018 video Neely gave about 33 BPM as the slowest tempo that people can feel as a beat. The tempo of Threshold is the same number.
parameters: 33 BPM = 1.8 s between beats. The video was not read for this study
where: Video: What is the slowest music humanly possible? (2018)

content: The live set quotes other music: a Bach cello suite, the Jupiter theme of Holst and Nimrod of Elgar in the bass solo, Jason Derulo songs as 'electrojazz' remixes, a rhythm from the meme track 'Cbat', and a Mahavishnu Orchestra cover as encore.
parameters: 5 types of quotation

item: Dance music styles inside the pieces
content: Dance styles that the sources name, by piece.
parameters: Dubstep: Dream of Mahjong; the 2012 remix; brostep transition in Thicc. Drum and bass tempo: Against the Fall of Night (174 BPM feel). Disco with four-on-the-floor kick: Hot Saturn (156 BPM). Chiptune: Threshold, Cytherean, Hot Saturn. Chillwave and city pop: Macchina, Lunar. Vaporwave-like synths and voices: 2021 album

item: Order of work on a tune
content: 1 A concept or mood (dark, or bright and funky). 2 A chord progression and a groove on keyboard or guitar. 3 A melody that he sings over the chords. 4 Orchestration: who plays the melody and in which octave. 5 The bass line last. Shofukan started from the rhythm of a pop song that he heard wrong in a shop.
parameters: League: "singing melodies ends up creating much better melodies"
where: Interview of 2014; article on a film about the band

content: The solo starts with a simple chord sequence. It becomes more complex, goes higher, and gets faster. The backing of the rhythm section grows through the solo. The horns enter late in the solo. The soloist goes outside the structure of the bass and drums and then comes back to the groove.
parameters: Build time 3:55. Order in the sources: chords first; fast unison lines; horns join later

item: Cue and trading after a solo
content: Lingus: one statement of the Bo Diddley beat by drums and percussion ends the solo. Then a processed trumpet and the synth trade four-bar phrases. Other tracks: horns trade on the outro; 3 or 4 drummers trade solos.
parameters: Recurrent: 8 drum solos and 7 changes of drummer in about 5 minutes
where: Lingus; Waves Upon Waves; Bad Kids to the Back; Recurrent

content: Shofukan ends with the first melody as a shout chorus. The horns lead; the band and the audience sing. A critic: the track goes from a 'cinematic' world-music groove to a sing-along and then to a percussion jam.
parameters: The melody must be simple enough to sing: League writes melodies by singing

item: A late turn to a bright last section
content: Trinity ends with a joyful peak after a dark start. East Bay starts with dissonance between the sax and the other horns and goes to a major-key groove in the second half. As You Are But Not As You Were has a false ending before a triumphant last section. In It Stays With You the strings resolve the tension into a triumphant motif.
parameters: Dark to bright in 4 of the tracks that the reviews describe

item: Openings and endings in the reviews
content: Openings: 3 snare rolls at the same time (Take It!); a talkbox melody (Fuel City); a guitar line alone (Shofukan); Rhodes with stereo vibrato (Waves Upon Waves). Endings: a Minimoog solo (Keep It On Your Mind); drum breaks for 3 drummers (Take It!); keyboards alone (Drift); a fade on an arpeggio riff (It Stays With You); in concert a church-style organ and talkbox outro, a faster tempo near the end (Tio Macaco), and a drum solo as the close (What About Me?).
parameters: Chimera: the orchestra plays its melody out of time, each player alone, after Lonely Woman by Ornette Coleman
where: Empire Central; Somni; We Like It Here; concerts of 2015
source: storm-empire; storm-somni; albumism-wlih; storm-raleigh; storm-mannheim; storm-seattle; downbeat-somni

item: Arranging for band and orchestra: method
content: Sylva: League and Jules Buckley arranged the music. Somni: League wrote all the music first; then 4 arrangers worked for 3 days in Berlin, each with fixed tasks. The band met 2 or 3 days before the orchestra came, to fix entries and voicings.
parameters: League sent the Somni demos to the band about 2 weeks before the recording. He writes in Logic with MIDI sounds

content: False ages and jobs in the official text. Joke titles.
parameters: "6 year old sheep investigator from Texas". A cover of "Giant Steps" with a rude new name. Small "i" in all titles (SMiLE, SNiFF, PiLOT)

content: A helper breaks a prop chair on his head during a fast drum solo. Singers wear skeleton suits.
parameters: Titles: "Park Your Car on My Face"; "Do Hot Girls Like Chords?"; "Bank Account" (fear of the bank balance). He says the humour is how he talks

content: Session videos shot in the house with tape filters and old game graphics.
parameters: A robot that holds a tambourine, built for the bonus track

content: Recorded voices come between and inside the tracks.
parameters: Phone calls; a eulogy; his son's stories. Cover with letters like an 8-bit video game
where: Beat Music! Beat Music! Beat Music!

content: The sound that gave 'djent' its name: a palm-muted power chord or single low note with heavy distortion on the lowest strings of a 7- or 8-string guitar. The notes are short and dry.
parameters: Note length not more than two sixteenths ('Stengah'). Energy of the palm-muted note at 150 to 250 Hz. Dampers on the strings behind the nut: a foam mute on all Meshuggah guitars; tape or a fret wrap in the studio and on stage
source: mit-tesseract; wiki-djent; rose-2013; ntm-eq-chart; pg-meshuggah-rig; sw-mansoor; gruv-bentley

content: A slap-bass technique moved to the guitar. The thumb strikes down through a low string and comes back up (two notes); a finger plucks the next note; the fretting hand hammers more notes.
parameters: Hand in a thumbs-up shape, motion from the wrist. Cells of 3 to 7 notes. A pitched note marks the start of each cell; the other notes are muted. Sources of the technique: Larry Graham and Victor Wooten. The thump tone is dry, so the weight must come from syncopation
where: The Woven Web; An Infinite Regression

content: Selective picking is between alternate picking and legato: some notes are picked, the others are hammered by the fretting hand with no pick stroke. Hybrid picking adds the fingers. 'Swybrid' joins sweep picking and finger plucks.
parameters: Basic cell in sixteenths: two picked notes, two hammered notes. Hybrid figure: a finger plucks one repeated note on each beat while the fretting hand hammers arpeggios between (sextuplets). Swybrid allows string skips in arpeggios

content: The picking hand taps a note one octave above the fretted note, or adds the top note of an arpeggio. The fretting hand alone can sound a riff with hammer-ons.
parameters: Octave taps: 12 frets above the fretting hand on the same string ('CAFO'). Tapped arpeggio: four notes on two strings plus a tapped note at fret 12. Mute the other strings with a light barre and the side of the picking hand. Tapping to extend arpeggios is common to most players of the style

content: A loud, dense, dissonant chord of the full band. Sun Ra gives the cue by hand.
parameters: Uses: start of a piece (long held), punctuation between solos, climax, ending. Described as "complexly-voiced, fortissimo"; also low and "throbbing". A band member: "chord against chord, melody against melody, and rhythm against rhythm". No fixed notes
where: Other Planes of There; concerts of 1964 to 1978

item: Space chord: definition of the biographer
content: The biographer John Szwed defines the space chord.
parameters: A tone cluster that the band improvises together at high volume. It can suggest a new melody or rhythm. Standard citation; not confirmed in a source during this study

content: Sun Ra points at players to start and stop them. Small groups form and dissolve.
parameters: Cue "by simply pointing" (Szwed). Duos and trios around bowed bass, piano, and Clavioline. The full band plays together only near the end. For Strange Strings the players got no notes, only the cue

content: The engineer feeds the output of the tape recorder back to its input. He plays the echo with the volume control.
parameters: Ampex 602 recorder, bought 1962. Cable from the output jack to the input. The playback volume makes the echo fast or slow or stops it. On two rhythm-section pieces of 2:22 and 2:27; also at the start of The Magic City
where: Art Forms of Dimensions Tomorrow; Cosmic Tones for Mental Therapy

content: All players take percussion instruments. Long sections of drums and small percussion have no tune.
parameters: Each concert has one or more long percussion jams. Instruments: log drums, "lightning drum", "space drums", timpani, bells, tuned bongos. Heavily percussive music with no continuous beat (1965)

content: Short unison songs with simple words. The band sings them and marches. A singer or the leader speaks texts over organ chords.
parameters: Chant sections of about 2 min inside long pieces. A chant ends the piece after the climax (Atlantis). 4 singers (1972). Dancers, costumes, light show, fire-eaters (1968 to 1970)
where: Space Is the Place; Atlantis; concerts

content: A slow ostinato in five or seven for bass and keyboard. Free solo lines go over it.
parameters: 5/4: Angels and Demons at Play; Mu; Lemuria; Exotic Forest; Intergalactic Universe. 7/4: The Shadow World. Bars of 5/4 and 9/4 over a gong drone on G, with irregular gong strokes at the start: Circe

content: The horn players get string instruments that they cannot play or tune. The aim is sound with no habits.
parameters: "a study in ignorance" (Sun Ra). Ukuleles, mandolins, kotos, koras, Chinese lutes; a large sheet of metal. No sense of key: "all texture" (Szwed). Heavy reverb

content: Electric piano and saxophone with echo play with no beat. Then silence. Then the riff starts and the layers enter one by one.
parameters: 0:00 to 0:30 texture; 2 s of silence; riff at 0:30; new layers at about 1:00, 1:30, and 2:00; track length 13:10

content: A drone, a texture, or a groove runs for a long time before the theme. Lengths in seconds.
parameters: Openings: 30 s (Ostinato); about 240 s of drone (Wandering Spirit Song, track 21:26); about 180 s before the horn theme (Hidden Shadows, track 10:11); 18.5 s of synthesizer riff (Birdland, computed from 12 bars at 156 BPM); 150 s (Milky Way, full track). Coda: 116 s (Hornets, from the cue at 17:39 to 19:35)
where: Mwandishi; Sextant; Heavy Weather; Weather Report (1971)
source: gluck-pod; iverson-mwandishi; hh-sextant; wiki-mwandishi; wiki-sextant; nzm-birdland; songbpm-cosmic; wr-bianchi-1971

content: Wind, bird, chime, and drone sounds from the synthesizer around the band.
parameters: Wind from the noise generator; chime tones; resonant bass drone; oscillators tuned in intervals with pitch bend; metal tones from the ring modulator (at 1:12, 1:35, 2:16, 4:18, 6:07, 7:07 of an 8:32 track)

content: One player holds a piano chord with no sound. The other plays the same chord with the saxophone into the piano. Only the ring of the strings is on the tape.
parameters: 2 min 30 s; the tape starts after each attack; different chords are recorded and then joined; no electronic instrument. It opens the first album

content: A track starts with the sound of a place. One track is a home cassette with later overdubs.
parameters: Black Market: home tape of voices. Barbary Coast: train. 8:30: short-wave radio from a cassette. Jungle Book (7:22): cassette improvisation with the voices of children; kalimba, guitar, and tabla added later

content: A tanpura drone runs through the piece. Harp glissandi and a modal solo go over it. The organ has the tone of a drone instrument.
parameters: Tanpura on 4 of 5 tracks (1970) and on 2 of 6 tracks (1971). She compared the tone of the Wurlitzer organ to harmonium and tanpura

content: Short acoustic tracks or noise tracks with no drums separate the fast pieces.
parameters: A Lotus on Irish Streams 5:39 (acoustic). Thousand Island Park 3:23 (acoustic guitar, piano, bass). Sapphire Bullets of Pure Love 0:24 (synthesizer noise). One stroke of a gong or cymbal opens Birds of Fire
where: The Inner Mounting Flame; Birds of Fire

content: Captures a piece of the input and repeats it.
parameters: Interval 1/32 to 4 bars; Offset in 16ths; Grid = slice size (large values give loops, small values give artefacts); Gate = total length in 16ths (4/16 = one beat); Chance 0 to 100 percent; Variation of the grid; Pitch and Pitch Decay (each repeat lower); modes Mix, Insert, Gate

content: Samples the input into a buffer all the time and plays "gestures" from MIDI notes.
parameters: Gesture length from 2 bars down to a 16th-note triplet; timeline grid from 1 bar to a 64th note; stutter values 1/2 to 1/1024 with dotted and triplet forms; pitched repeats from C2 to B6; modules: gate width, jump pan, buffer position, stereo delay, low-pass, high-pass, bit reduction, lo-fi

content: Step sequencer with several effect lanes that play at the same time.
parameters: 128 scenes, one for each MIDI note; effects locked to the tempo (16th notes, eighth-note triplets); modules include retrigger and stretcher; functions Randomize and Mutate

content: Effects painted as blocks on a step grid.
parameters: 32 steps; 14 effects locked to the tempo; 12 patterns by MIDI key; loop, scratch, reverse, stretch, tonal delay, stutter (gate)

content: Two ways to lower the quality: a lower sample rate and a lower bit resolution. Usual in glitch, lo-fi and chiptune music.
parameters: Ableton Redux: Rate (new sample rate) and Jitter (noise on the clock); dubstep bass example: a bitcrusher adds clipping and top end

content: A short filtered delay with a random LFO.
parameters: Delay time 6 sixteenths; feedback 50 percent; band-pass at 2.86 kHz; sample-and-hold LFO at 0.93 Hz; dry/wet 50 to 80 percent

content: A gate on a held sound opens only on drum hits. A filter can follow the drum level in the same way.
parameters: Example at 160 BPM; pad from two saw waves 15 to 30 cents apart; band-pass at 70 Hz with envelope amount 70

content: A large stretch smears the drum attacks and gives a "phasey and diffuse" sound. UK garage uses time-stretched and pitch-shifted voices as a colour.
parameters: Strongest at ratios that are not whole numbers

item: Tape stop, reverse and pitch ramp
content: Usual lengths.
parameters: Tape stop: the pitch falls to zero in 1/2 beat to 1 bar. Reverse: the last 1/8 or 1/4 note before a downbeat. Pitch ramp on a retrigger: 12 semitones up or down in one beat. Estimate

content: Record a layered sound to one new sample and build on it. Jungle producers sample breaks that were sampled before ("second generation").
parameters: The "Tramen" break: three layered breaks pushed into distortion, resampled and chopped again. Two clap layers resampled into one clap

item: Risers, noise sweeps and sub drop
content: A sound that rises in pitch, with a layer of filtered white noise above it. Low-pass and high-pass filters move during the riser. A noise up-sweep and a sub drop lead into the build.
parameters: The riser must not go too high in pitch; reverb puts it in the background

content: Usual values.
parameters: 2, 4 or 8 bars; the sweep stops 1/2 bar or 1 bar before the drop. Estimate

content: The DJ pulls the record back by hand and starts the track again. The pull-back makes a whirring noise.
parameters: From dub and reggae sound systems

item: Bebop scales put chord tones on the beats
content: A seven-note scale gets one chromatic passing tone. With eight notes the chord tones stay on the beats in a scale run. Dominant scale: the tone between the flat seventh and the root. Major scale: the tone between the fifth and the sixth.
parameters: 8-note scales; chord tones on the beat, passing tones off the beat
where: Bebop practice of Parker and Gillespie

content: The line moves to a scale or chord a semitone above or below the given chord and then resolves. Variants: play only the five notes outside the scale; add a ii-V a semitone above the original ii-V.
parameters: Shift +1 or -1 semitone; resolve back

item: Outside tools in one postbop solo
content: Side-stepping: a Gm7 arpeggio over Gb7. A minor pentatonic scale a fifth above the root (B-flat minor over E-flat 7) for a sus sound. Stacks of rising fourths. Chromatic passing tones on strong beats. Dominant chords a minor third apart from the diminished scale.
parameters: Pentatonic on the fifth; arpeggio +1 semitone; fourths; minor-third cycle of dominant 7 flat 9 chords
where: 'I Mean You' and other solos; analysis by Zaddach

content: The altered scale is the seventh mode of the ascending melodic minor scale. Over a dominant chord it gives the flat ninth, sharp ninth, flat fifth and flat thirteenth. It has no natural ninth, fifth or thirteenth.
parameters: Dominant 7 alt: melodic minor a semitone above the root

artist: McCoy Tyner; Miles Davis and Bill Evans
content: The 'So What' chord has three perfect fourths and a major third on top. In fourth voicings a minor 11 chord and a dominant sus chord are the same notes; the bass root decides. Tyner's playing in the Coltrane quartet set the model.
parameters: Voicing: 4th + 4th + 4th + major 3rd; lines: 5 to 7 semitone steps (10% of all intervals, measured)

item: Sheets of sound: three chords over one
content: Coltrane put three chords over one: over C7 he added E-flat 7 and F-sharp 7. The lines are often faster than sixteenth notes and use quintuplets and septuplets. Runs can have hundreds of notes from the lowest to the highest register.
parameters: Superimpose dominants a minor third and a tritone away; odd tuplets of 5 and 7

content: A ghost note is a snare stroke at very low volume. Drummers play ghost notes on the off-beat sixteenth notes between the main notes. They give a soft sixteenth-note feel under a strong backbeat.
parameters: Position: off-beat 16ths; level: see the measured ratio 0.28

content: An enclosure puts a target chord tone between an upper and a lower neighbour: usually a scale step above and a semitone below. It has two to four notes and the target is on a beat. A single approach note is usually a semitone below the target.
parameters: Enclosure: +1 or +2, then -1, then the target on the beat
where: Not confirmed in a source in this task

item: Triad pairs, diminished and whole-tone material
content: A triad pair uses two triads with no common tone, usually a whole step apart, in cells of three notes. The half-whole diminished scale is used over dominant 7 flat 9 chords. The whole-tone scale is used over dominant 7 sharp 5 chords.
parameters: Triad pair: 6 notes in 3-note cells; diminished scale: 8 notes
where: Not confirmed in a source in this task

item: Unison lines compared with improvised lines
content: A written unison or soli line has fixed pitches and is played by two or more instruments together. It is usually longer than an improvised phrase, has fewer rests, and uses sequences and rhythmic hits with the drums. The players align their onsets closely.
parameters: No measured values found
